🗓️
On
November 17, 2026
, Russian Ambassador to Indonesia
Sergei Tolchenov
attended the opening of the Russia-ASEAN Dialogue Forum of Women in High-Tech Industries in Jakarta, held under the theme “Unity in Diversity: Women for Technology, Energy and Inclusive Prosperity.”
The Forum was organised by the Rosatom Women’s Community and the Indonesian Nuclear Society (HIMNI), with the support of Rosatom State Corporation, the Council of the Eurasian Women’s Forum, the International Council for the Support and Development of Women in Industry and Technology, the ASEAN Confederation of Women’s Organisations, and the Indonesian Business Women’s Association (IWAPI).
🤝
Discussions focused on
expanding opportunities for women in high-tech industries
, including nuclear energy, advancing engineering education, workforce training, technology entrepreneurship, and implementing joint projects between Russia and ASEAN countries.
🎙️
In his remarks,
Sergei Tolchenov
noted that the strategic partnership established between Russia and Indonesia in June 2025 reflects growing interest in cooperation across various sectors of the economy, particularly high technology. He also stressed the importance of expanding opportunities for women in technical fields, science and management, supporting their professional development, and encouraging their participation in a wide range of projects.
🇮🇩
Indonesia’s Vice Minister of Higher Education, Science and Technology
Stella Christie
highlighted women’s contribution to global scientific progress and expressed support for cooperation between Russian and Indonesian women’s organisations in advancing technological innovation.
✔️
Participants’ proposals for strengthening international cooperation in high-tech industries will be reflected in the Jakarta Action Plan - 2026 "Women in Technology".

item.title: 🇷🇺 Embassy of Russia in Burundi On 17 November, Ambassador of Russia to Burundi Sergey Chernenko
item.description: 🇷🇺 🇧🇮 Embassy of Russia in Burundi : On 17 November, Ambassador of Russia to Burundi Sergey Chernenko took part in an official ceremony in Bujumbura to transfer Russian humanitarian aid to Burundi , with support from the country office of the UN World Food Programme ( #WFP ). Burundi received 1,100 tonnes of food aid – wheat, peas and flour – worth $2 million . The supplies will reach 8,000 of the most vulnerable households across the country. The ceremony was also attended by Acting Country Director of WFP in Burundi Arduino Mangoni , and Director General of the Programme for Regional Integration and International Cooperation at Burundi’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs Adolphe Nahayo . 🤝 In their remarks, participants thanked Russia for providing humanitarian aid and supporting the people of Burundi. #RussiaHelps

item.title: 📆 On November 17, the United Nations Industrial Development Organisation (UNIDO) marked
item.description: 📆 On November 17, the United Nations Industrial Development Organisation (UNIDO) marked the 60th anniversary. In 1966, on the initiative of the Soviet Union, UNIDO was established as an autonomous organisation within the #UN , and in 1985, thanks to the efforts of the USSR, it was granted the status of a UN specialised agency. ☝️ Over the past six decades, the Organisation has promoted inclusive and sustainable industrial development across its member states , particularly in Africa, strengthening their productive capacities and integration into the global economy. As a global forum, it facilitates international dialogue on promoting industrialisation, bringing together representatives of the public and private sectors alongside non-governmental and academic organisations. 🤝 The Russian Federation is a long-standing and reliable partner of the Organisation. As an active participant and key donor to international efforts in sustainable industrial development, Russia attaches particular importance to multilateral cooperation within the relevant bodies of the UN system. During the forthcoming 54th session of the Industrial Development Board , scheduled for November 23–25, a number of commemorative events are scheduled to mark the Organisation’s anniversary, including a thematic seminar entitled “Russia and UNIDO: 60 Years Together” .

Urdu Translation of Zakhar Prilepin’s "Militia Romance" Presented at the Russian Embassy in Pakistan
On November 17, the Embassy of Russia in Pakistan hosted the presentation of the Urdu translation of "Militia Romance", a collection of short stories by renowned Russian writer Zakhar Prilepin.
🤝
The event was attended by
Ambassador Albert P. Khorev
; Federal Minister of National Heritage and Culture
Aurangzeb Khan Khichi
; MNA and Parliamentary Secretary
Farah Naz Akbar
; Director General of the National Language Promotion Department
Dr. Muhammad Saleem Mazhar
, as well as Ambassadors of friendly countries and representatives of Pakistan’s intellectual community.
🎥
In a video address to the participants, the author,
Zakhar Prilepin
, expressed his gratitude to the Russian Embassy and Pakistani colleagues for their assistance in translating and publishing the book in Urdu.
💬
In his opening remarks,
Ambassador Albert P. Khorev
spoke about Zakhar Prilepin’s life and literary career. He emphasized the importance of the book for
understanding the root causes of the conflict in Ukraine
, the history of the struggle of the people of Donbass and their determination to preserve their historical, cultural and spiritual identity.
Addressing the Ukraine crisis, the Ambassador drew attention to the
extensive Western military and financial support to
Kiev, which contributes to prolonging the conflict.
He also highlighted the
Western disinformation campaign aimed at demonizing Russia
through the manipulation of humanitarian and cultural issues.
❗️
Ambassador Khorev reaffirmed
Russia’s commitment to a political and diplomatic settlement of the crisis:
“We are not fighting for territory. We are fighting to protect our borders and to establish a stable European security architecture based on the principles of equal and indivisible security.”
🙏
In conclusion, the Ambassador thanked the translator,
Dr. Najam Sahar Butt,
for his initiative and outstanding professionalism, which made it possible to preserve the philosophical depth of the original work.
🤝
Federal Minister of National Heritage and Culture Aurangzeb Khan Khichi highlighted the
strength of Russia-Pakistan diplomatic, trade and economic ties
and emphasized the considerable potential for expanding bilateral cooperation in culture, science and education.
#RussiaPakistan
